name: Rwanda
description: Rwanda from its kingdom to German and Belgian rule, independence in 1962, the genocide against the Tutsi in 1994 and the rebuilding since.

checkpoints.name: The kingdom
checkpoints.note: The kings of Rwanda ruled the hills for centuries.

checkpoints.name: Colonial rule
checkpoints.note: Germany and then Belgium ruled, and Belgium made Hutu and Tutsi into fixed groups on identity cards.

checkpoints.name: Independence and genocide
checkpoints.note: Rwanda became independent in 1962. In 1994 some 800,000 people, mostly Tutsi, were killed in a hundred days.

checkpoints.name: Rebuilding
checkpoints.note: The RPF ended the genocide, and Rwanda has rebuilt under Kagame.
